I also found little direct evidence on unemployment policy beyond the labor-market statistics themselves; the record is much stronger on inflation, food shocks, and disaster response than on jobs policy.","evidence":[{"title":"Philippines: 2024 Article IV Consultation-Press Release; and Staff Report","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-12-19","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/12/17/pr-24478-philippines-imf-concludes-2024-article-iv-consultation","summary":"The IMF said the Philippines handled multiple external headwinds well, growth stayed resilient, inflation fell from 6.0% in 2023 to 3.2% in 2024, and fiscal consolidation was underway. This is the strongest broad competence signal.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.3","5B.6"]},{"title":"Philippines: 2024 Article IV Consultation-Press Release; and Staff Report","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-12-19","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/12/19/philippines-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-and-staff-report-559739","summary":"The staff report says growth recovered, inflation stayed within target, debt was being managed through gradual consolidation, and risks came mainly from commodity volatility, natural disasters, and stalled reforms. That suggests a calibrated response rather than blunt overreaction.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6"]},{"title":"Infra dev’t, aid support ramped up as El Niño, La Niña tested PH","publisher":"Philippine News Agency","date":"2024-12-26","url":"https://www.pna.gov.ph/index.php/articles/1240576","summary":"The report says Marcos responded promptly to El Niño, typhoons, cash aid, food packs, evacuation centers, and flood-control planning. This is honest about external drivers, though it underplays domestic policy failure.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7"]},{"title":"Marcos opens 2024 SONA admitting rice prices are costly","publisher":"GMA News Online","date":"2024-07-22","url":"https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/914278/marcos-opens-2024-sona-admitting-rice-prices-are-costly/story/","summary":"Marcos publicly acknowledged that official statistics meant little to families facing rice at P45-P65/kg. This shows the shock was severe and not yet under control in early 2024.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.3"]},{"title":"Philippine central bank governor rules out easing rates 'soon'","publisher":"Reuters / Investing.com","date":"2024-03-05","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/philippine-central-bank-governor-rules-out-easing-rates-soon-3325861","summary":"The BSP said it was too soon to declare victory over inflation because rice and other food prices were still driving expectations. This is useful counterevidence to any claim of quick stabilization.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.3"]},{"title":"NEDA: Reduced rice tariffs failed to lower prices","publisher":"GMA News Online","date":"2024-12-10","url":"https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/money/economy/929579/neda-reduced-rice-tariffs-failed-to-lower-prices/story/","summary":"NEDA said the rice tariff cut did not reduce retail rice prices as anticipated. That undercuts the administration’s earlier claim that the intervention was already working.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7"]},{"title":"PBBM admin made every effort to shield Filipinos from high food prices, keeps inflation within target in 2024","publisher":"Department of Finance","date":"2024-12-17","url":"https://www.dof.gov.ph/pbbm-admin-made-every-effort-to-shield-filipinos-from-high-food-prices-keeps-inflation-within-target-in-2024/","summary":"DOF said inflation ended 2024 at 3.2%, rice prices moderated, and low-income households benefited after tariff cuts and other interventions. This supports the case that the government’s intervention helped absorb shocks.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7"]},{"title":"Sona 2024 fact check","publisher":"Philippine Daily Inquirer","date":"2024-07-23","url":"https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1964296/sona-2024-fact-check","summary":"Independent fact-checkers rated Marcos’s claim that prices were mainly driven by external forces as inaccurate or incomplete, while also finding some rice-output claims correct. This is the best evidence that his public explanation was partly overstated.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7"]},{"title":"2024 average inflation eased to 3.2% as gov’t interventions sustained rice price moderation, benefitting low-income families","publisher":"Department of Finance","date":"2025-01-07","url":"https://www.dof.gov.ph/recto-2024-average-inflation-eased-to-3-2-as-govt-interventions-sustained-rice-price-moderation-benefitting-low-income-families/","summary":"Looking back at 2024, DOF credited interventions with keeping inflation within target and lowering rice inflation sharply by year-end. This supports a positive final-year stabilization outcome, especially for poorer households.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.3","5B.8"]},{"title":"Philippines’ budget surplus at P6.3 billion in October","publisher":"Reuters / Interaksyon","date":"2024-11-27","url":"https://interaksyon.philstar.com/business/2024/11/27/287793/philippines-budget-surplus-at-6-3-billion-in-october/","summary":"The government posted an October budget surplus and narrowed the year-to-date deficit versus the prior year. This is modest positive evidence on fiscal handling, though it is only one month and not a full-year verdict.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.3"]},{"title":"Marcos’ cautious economic outlook on El Nino, geopolitical risks","publisher":"Reuters / Investing.com","date":"2024-01-12","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/philippines-marcos-gives-cautious-economic-outlook-on-el-nino-geopolitical-risks-3273028","summary":"Marcos publicly framed the outlook as constrained by El Niño and geopolitical risks and appointed Recto while praising his understanding of the economy. This is a reasonable, non-panicked framing of risk.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.2"]}]}
